name: DKCTF Hard Mode – P2 through initializer
notes: Try 9 keeps the confirmed third-argument parser but no longer writes the selected Kong directly to state+0x269C. The callback stores the mapped P2 ID temporarily at state+0x26C0. Hard Mode initialization loads that temporary ID at 0x1E7000 and performs the original P2 store at 0x1E700C, in the same initializer that stores P1. This removes the failed UpdateCharacterTypes quit-restore approach and tests whether using the normal initializer lifecycle prevents the Hard Mode Kong from persisting after manual quit.

entries.description: Preserve the confirmed independent-P2 Hard Mode state.
Load the mapped Hard Mode P2 ID from temporary state+0x26C0 instead of generating automatic P2 ID 1.
Remove the DK-specific increment; W8 already contains the exact selected P2 ID.
Preserve the active P2 slot bit during Hard Mode initialization.
Retain the compact parser control flow for the existing third initLevelTransition argument.
Parse and map the existing P2 slider, but store the result temporarily at state+0x26C0 instead of changing the persistent current-P2 field before initialization.
Keep the temporary P2 ID alive until the Hard Mode initializer consumes it.
